program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((h (obj-h obj))
             (w (obj-w obj))
             (perim (+ (* 2 w) (* 2 (- h 2)))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3)
             (= (obj-size obj) perim)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                         (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (in-list (filter frame? (objects g 0)))])
      (if (and (= (modulo (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)) 2) 0)
               (= (modulo (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj)) 2) 0))
          (set-cell out
                    (quotient (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) 2)
                    (quotient (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) 2)
                    (obj-color obj))
          out))))
